orientation.zh: 图示北向仅为采光与动线推演，尚无实际地块。
orientation.en: North is a planning assumption; no actual site has been selected.

areaNote.zh: 约 200㎡ 总建面的单层独栋工作模型：净功能分区 166㎡，另预留 34㎡ 给墙体、结构与机电。庭院 30㎡ 单独列示，不计入这 200㎡。图中尺寸为概念控制线，并非可施工的净尺寸。
areaNote.en: A single-storey, approximately 200 m² gross-floor-area working model: 166 m² of net program plus a provisional 34 m² for walls, structure and services. The 30 m² courtyard is outdoors and separate. Dimensions are conceptual control lines, not construction clearances.

capacity.zh: 先满足一个人的日常，也为伴侣、来客与未来变化留下余地。四间可关门的房间是主卧、书房、客房／多用室与预留室，并非四间卧室。
capacity.en: Designed first for one person's daily life, with room for a partner, guests and future changes. Four enclosed rooms mean a bedroom, a study, a guest / multipurpose room and a reserve room—not four bedrooms.

feasibility.zh: 建筑师需结合地块、朝向、气候、结构、消防、排水与当地审批重做方案和施工图。面积与家具尺度仅用于讨论。
feasibility.en: An architect must revise the design for the actual site, climate, structure, fire safety, drainage and local approvals. Areas and furniture sizes are discussion tools.

subtitle.zh: 朝庭院展开的公共核心
subtitle.en: The shared heart, open to the courtyard

dimensions.en: 10 × 3.4 m main bay, plus a 4 × 1.5 m return

narrative.zh: 把一天里最好的光留给读书、喝茶和相处。低矮家具让视线越过窗台；藏书沿回廊一侧展开，庭院成为房间的远景。客厅不以电视墙为中心，而围绕书、茶桌和窗外的树组织。
narrative.en: Reserve the best light for reading, tea and time together. Low furniture keeps the view open; books line the gallery edge and the courtyard supplies the distant view. The room gathers around books, a tea table and a tree rather than a television wall.

zh: 茶席靠餐厨；杯具与在读书归入 F-L10，备水、冲泡、清洗与归柜一并考虑。
长窗设置外遮阳与可开启扇，避免只追求整面玻璃。
本版已核对 0.75–0.9m 的主要概念通行带；真实项目继续优化净宽，书墙承重与防潮另行核算。
en: Tea sits near the kitchen. F-L10 holds cups and current reading; plan filling, brewing, cleaning and return together.
Combine large windows with external shading and operable sections.
The main concept routes have checked 0.75–0.9 m bands; develop clear widths for the real project and verify book loads and moisture.

subtitle.zh: 可以真正关上门的深度工作空间
subtitle.en: A door that protects focused work

narrative.zh: 计算机、写作与阅读拥有一间安静的房间。书桌侧向庭院取光，墙面保留给书架、草图与思考。白天有自然光，夜间可独立开灯，不必让工作扩散进卧室。
narrative.en: A quiet room for computing, writing and reading. The desk receives side light from the courtyard; walls hold books, sketches and unfinished thoughts. Work can continue under its own light without taking over the bedroom.

zh: 预留 1.8–2.2m 宽、0.75–0.85m 深的桌面与显示器距离。
双屏在 2.1 × 0.8m 桌面后沿；计算设备进入东侧通风柜，供电、网线和检修共同设计。
门缝、隔墙与通风消声共同决定隔音，不能只加吸音板。
en: Allow a 1.8–2.2 m desk width and 0.75–0.85 m depth.
Two displays sit at the back of a 2.1 × 0.8 m desk. Compute equipment has an east-side ventilated cabinet; coordinate power, data and servicing.
Acoustic privacy depends on the door, partitions and ventilation—not panels alone.

subtitle.zh: 安睡优先，减少功能侵入

narrative.zh: 卧室只保留睡眠、穿衣和放松。整面收纳消化杂物，床边留出真实的通行空间。窗外的光经过纱帘与遮光帘逐层进入，不把整间房变成需要表演的展示间。
narrative.en: Keep sleep, dressing and quiet rest here. A continuous wardrobe absorbs clutter and genuine walking space remains around the bed. Sheer and blackout curtains temper the light, leaving a bedroom that can be lived in.

zh: 图中床为 1.8 × 2.0m 示意，柜深约 0.6m。
保留两侧下床与开柜空间，避免把净面积全给床。
卧室新风、空调噪声和夜间遮光应进入设备方案。
en: The plan shows a 1.8 × 2.0 m bed and approximately 0.6 m-deep wardrobe.
Keep space to get out on both sides and open storage.
Include ventilation, equipment noise and blackout in the services design.

subtitle.zh: 可以每日做饭，也能招待几位朋友

narrative.zh: 餐桌成为工作、吃饭与谈话之间温和的过渡。厨房靠服务边布置，水、电与排烟集中；面向起居区保持交流，同时预留未来加玻璃移门的可能。
narrative.en: A dining table forms a gentle transition between work, meals and conversation. Water, power and extraction share a service edge. The kitchen stays connected to living, with the option of a future glazed sliding partition.

zh: 洗、切、炒连续布置，操作区与餐椅活动范围分别核对。
图中餐桌为 1.8 × 0.9m，配四把餐椅，西侧保留连续通道。
明火或重油烟需求可能影响开敞厨房与门窗方案。
en: Keep wash, prep and cooking in sequence; check counter and dining-chair clearances separately.
The 1.8 × 0.9 m table has four chairs, with a continuous route along its west side.
Fuel and cooking habits may change the open-kitchen and extraction strategy.

narrative.zh: 不用为偶尔来客长期空置一间标准客房。可展开的床、整洁收纳和一张小桌，让它平日用于伸展、阅读或临时合作，来客时又能关门独处。
narrative.en: An occasional guest should not leave a room idle all year. A fold-out bed, tidy storage and a small desk support stretching, reading or temporary collaboration, then provide privacy when someone stays.

zh: 展开床后仍应保留到门与窗的通道。
不要用高低差或固定榻榻米阻断未来家具变化。
若将来变为长期卧室，须重新核验采光、通风与收纳。
en: Keep a route to the door and window with the bed unfolded.
Avoid fixed raised platforms that prevent future furniture changes.
Recheck daylight, ventilation and storage if it becomes a permanent bedroom.

subtitle.zh: 先保留改变生活的余地
subtitle.en: Space for a life that may change

narrative.zh: 这里不替未来预设唯一答案。它可以成为第二工作室、家人的房间或长期来客的卧室；前期仅完成基础照明、通风、电路与可调整收纳，让真正的需要慢慢出现。
narrative.en: This room does not prescribe one future. It could become another studio, a family room or a long-stay bedroom. Begin with light, ventilation, power and adaptable storage, allowing real needs to emerge.

zh: 先做可逆的软装，避免为尚未确定的功能定制大量柜体。
门窗位置支持日后放床、工作桌和衣柜三种基本布局。
不预埋未经设备需求验证的大型专用管线。
en: Start with reversible furnishing rather than extensive custom joinery.
Place doors and windows to support a bed, a desk or a wardrobe layout.
Avoid large dedicated service runs before equipment needs are known.

subtitle.zh: 完整浴室与独立客用洗手间
subtitle.en: A full bathroom and a guest WC

dimensions.en: A shared wet core of approximately 2.8 × 4.2 m

narrative.zh: 完整浴室和独立客用洗手间共享管线，朋友来访时不用进入卧室。分开的两扇门减少早晚冲突；小前室让回廊视线不直接对着洁具。
narrative.en: A full bathroom and a separate guest WC share services, so visitors need not enter a bedroom. Separate doors reduce morning conflicts and a small lobby keeps fixtures out of the gallery's direct view.

zh: 完整浴室约 7㎡，客用洗手间约 2.72㎡，小前室约 2.04㎡。
防水、排水坡度、检修、热水距离与强制排风优先于视觉效果。
当前客用洗手间为紧凑布局，并非已验证的无障碍卫生间。
en: Approximately 7 m² for the full bathroom, 2.72 m² for the guest WC and 2.04 m² for its lobby.
Waterproofing, drainage, access, hot-water runs and mechanical extraction come first.
The compact guest WC is not a verified accessible bathroom.

label.zh: 玄关 · 家务 · 回廊

subtitle.zh: 让收纳、家务与交通被认真设计
subtitle.en: Give storage and daily routines real space

dimensions.en: 12 m² entry / utility plus a 1.4 × 14 m gallery of 19.6 m²

narrative.zh: 回家先放下包、换鞋，再进入公共空间。洗衣、清洁用品和日常杂物有自己的位置。北侧房间由一条明确的回廊连接，它也可以陈列作品，但不会假装这部分交通面积不存在。
narrative.en: Put down a bag and change shoes before entering the shared rooms. Laundry, cleaning equipment and everyday clutter have places of their own. A clear gallery connects the northern rooms and can display work; its circulation area is counted honestly.

zh: 其中玄关／洗衣／收纳 12㎡，回廊交通 19.6㎡；后续可继续优化交通占比。
1.4m 回廊不应再放深柜堵窄主通道，书柜优先嵌入相邻房间。
洗衣机、烘干机需核对排水、排风、振动与检修净空。
en: Includes 12 m² of entry, laundry and storage and 19.6 m² of gallery circulation; the latter remains open to optimization.
Do not narrow the 1.4 m gallery with deep storage; recess shelving into adjacent rooms.
Verify appliance drainage, ventilation, vibration and service clearances.

subtitle.zh: L 形室内围合的开放留白
subtitle.en: An outdoor room held by the L-shaped plan

dimensions.zh: 约 6 × 5m；不计入室内或总建面
dimensions.en: Approximately 6 × 5 m; separate from indoor and gross floor areas

narrative.zh: 留一棵会长大的树、一段可坐的檐下与能感知雨水的地面。庭院不急着塞满景观物件，先成为起居室和书房共同观看的空白。它接住光、风与四季，也需要真实的排水和维护。
narrative.en: Make room for a tree that can grow, a sheltered place to sit and ground that makes rain visible. The courtyard need not fill with objects: first let it become a shared view from living and study. It receives light, wind and seasons—and needs real drainage and care.

zh: 庭院属于独立室外面积，场地退界、围护和雨棚计容需当地核实。
树种与根系距离根据气候和基础位置确定。
大窗前应同时考虑夏季遮阳、雨水反溅、隐私与安全。
en: Confirm local setbacks, enclosure and canopy area rules.
Select trees and root distances for the climate and foundations.
Check summer shading, rain splash, privacy and security at large windows.
